notes.title: TRON: Catalyst Patch Notes
notes.content:
> RUN

> TRON_CATALYST_UPDATE




Greetings, User. 




The Arq Grid has received a patch, modifying the prices of the Parry skill tree.




Increased cost of Parry Window (was 1000, now 1500)

Increased cost of Parry Damage  (was 750, now 2000)




In addition to these changes, the following bugs have been derezzed: 




Fixed an issue where players could potentially become progress blocked.

Fixed an issue where players and enemy Light Cycles could fall out of the map.
